prose: 1Password has passed $500 million in ARR, up from $400 million in November 2025, with the Wall Street Journal attributing the growth to enterprise adoption of AI coding assistants and agents. The company also announced 1Password for Agents, extending its credential management to non-human actors, and reports double-digit free cash flow margins.
highlights: 1Password passed $500M ARR, up from $400M in November 2025 (WSJ)
Growth is driven by enterprise AI coding assistants and agents needing credentials
Announced 1Password for Agents, a product for non-human identities
Free cash flow margin reportedly in double digits
